name: finops
description: Read-only FinOps pack for Azure SRE Agent: fifteen skills including dynamic managed-scope enforcement and deterministic Live Report rendering, plus an installer (install-api.sh) that adds the autonomous finops-investigator agent and scheduled Live Reports; a plugin install alone imports only the skills. Budget planning can generate a validated shell script for a human to review and run manually; the agent executes no Azure writes and grants no write RBAC.
